```{r}
library(PlantFATE)

print(getwd())
```

```{r}
# Function to preview tables using kable
preview_table <- function(data, n=6) {
  data |> 
    head(n=n) |> 
    kable() |> 
    kable_styling() |> 
    column_spec(1:ncol(data), border_left = "solid lightgray", border_right = "solid lightgray") |> 
    scroll_box(width = "100%")
}

plot_gauss_mix = function(x, means, sds, wts, add=T, col, add_polygon=F, ...){
  y = x*0
  if (length(sds)==1) sds = rep(sds, length(means))
  for (i in 1:length(means)){
    y = y + wts[i]*dnorm(x, mean = means[i], sd=sds[i])
  }
  if (add) points(y~x, col=col, ...)
  else plot(y~x, col=col, ...)
  if (add_polygon){
    polygon(y~x, col=scales::alpha(col, 0.5), border = NA)
  }
}
```

## Analyze observed traits

```{r}
traits = read_csv("input_data/Plant_Traits_AmzFACE_for_PlantFATE_Orig.csv")

traits |> preview_table()
```


Plot observed distributions

```{r}

par(mfrow=c(2,2), mar=c(4,4,1,1), oma=c(1,1,1,1))
traits |> 
    select(Species, BA='Total BasalArea_2017(cm2)', WD='meanWoodDensity (g/cm3)', Hmat='Height_Max(m)', LMA='Leaf LMA (g/m2)', P50='P50 (Mpa)') |> 
    pivot_longer(-c(Species, BA)) |> 
    drop_na() |>
    group_by(name) |> 
    do(
        with(., 
          plot_gauss_mix(
            x=seq(min(value), max(value), length.out=100), 
            means=value, 
            sds=0.14*mean(abs(value), na.rm=T), 
            wts=BA/sum(BA), 
            add=F, 
            col="blue", 
            type="l",
            add_polygon=F,
            xlab=first(name),
            ylab = "Density"
          ) |> as.data.frame()
        )
    )
```


Calculate basal-area weighted mean traits from the observed data

```{r}
mean_traits = traits |> 
    select(Species, BA='Total BasalArea_2017(cm2)', WD='meanWoodDensity (g/cm3)', Hmat='Height_Max(m)', LMA='Leaf LMA (g/m2)', P50='P50 (Mpa)') |> 
    pivot_longer(-c(Species, BA)) |> 
    drop_na() |>
    group_by(name) |> 
    summarize(mean = sum(value*BA)/sum(BA),
              sd = sqrt(sum(BA*(value - mean(value))^2)/sum(BA)),
              n = n(),
              cv = sd/abs(mean),
              cv2 = cv^2)

mean_traits |> preview_table()

mt_wide = mean_traits |> 
    select(name, mean) |>
    pivot_wider(values_from = mean) |> 
    mutate(LMA = LMA/1000,
           WD = WD*1000) 
```

## Optimal traits

Now we will find the optimal traits for the given light environment

```{r}
input_dir = "input_data"
output_dir = "pfate_output"
prefix = "AmzMIP_AMB_ObsMeanTraits"
solver = "ebt"
dir = paste0("",output_dir,"/",prefix,"_",solver)

l = pf_read_outputs(input_dir, output_dir, expt_dir=prefix)

zstar = l$Zp |>
  filter(YEAR > (max(YEAR)-100)) |>
  summarize(across(everything(), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |> 
  pivot_longer(-YEAR) |>
  drop_na() |> 
  pull(value)
  
canopy_opennes = l$co |>
  filter(YEAR > (max(YEAR)-100)) |>
  summarize(across(everything(), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |> 
  pivot_longer(-YEAR) |>
  drop_na() |> 
  pull(value)

zstar |> 
  print()

canopy_opennes |> 
  print()
```

## Calculate fitness of a given species

```{r}
config_file = "config_files/p_amz_obs_mean_traits_sapwoodresp.ini"

lho = new(LifeHistoryOptimizer, config_file)
lho$init()
lho$printMeta()
lho$calcFitness()
```

## Compute fitness landscape

```{r}
fitness_wd = function(wd, p50, lma, hmat, zp, co, co2, pfile=config_file){
  lho = new(LifeHistoryOptimizer, pfile)
  lho$set_i_metFile("input_data/MetData_AmzFACE_Monthly_2000_2015_PlantFATE_new.csv")
  lho$set_a_metFile("input_data/MetData_AmzFACE_Monthly_2000_2015_PlantFATE_new.csv")
  lho$init_co2(co2)
  lho$env$z_star = zp
  lho$env$canopy_openness = co
  lho$traits0$wood_density = wd
  lho$traits0$p50_xylem = p50
  lho$traits0$hmat = hmat
  lho$traits0$lma = lma

  lho$init()
  # lho$printPlant()
  lho$calcFitness()
}

wd = seq(400, 900, length.out=20)

dat_wd = wd %>% purrr::map_dbl(.f = fitness_wd, p50=mt_wide$P50, hmat=mt_wide$Hmat, lma=mt_wide$LMA, zp=zstar, co=canopy_opennes, co2=368)

print(
tibble(wd=wd, fitness=dat_wd) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=wd, y=fitness)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x="Wood Density (g/cm3)", y="Fitness") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16)
)

p50 = seq(-4, -1, length.out=20)

dat_p50 = p50 %>% purrr::map_dbl(.f = fitness_wd, wd=mt_wide$WD, hmat=mt_wide$Hmat, lma=mt_wide$LMA, zp=zstar, co=canopy_opennes, co2=368)

print(
tibble(p50=p50, fitness=dat_p50) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=p50, y=fitness)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x="Xylem P50 (MPa)", y="Fitness") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16)
)

```
